rules.activation: Persist activation and next UTC midnight capture_start_ms, independent of existing pending live/replay. Fixed nonoverlapping 7-day cohorts. Never restart origin on redeploy.
rules.first_reclaim: Use registered VWAP candidate unchanged. Require uninterrupted fresh market observation from UTC midnight; mark a session unknown on first late/missed/incomplete observation. Consume first strict reclaim even if it fails volume/room. Do not backfill first reclaim from historical bars.
rules.control: Reuse frozen current_next_open candidate. Baseline already present or missed setups; require breakout 4H close >= cohort origin and after uninterrupted observation began. One first qualification per setup.
rules.signal_time: Keep original signal close+1ms created_ms and actual observed_ms separately. execution_start_ms=floor(observed_ms/15M)*15M+15M; exclude signal and partially elapsed capture candle.
rules.expiry: Keep signal close+4 bars VWAP, +2 bars current; never extend for capture delay.
rules.pending_state: Record registered frozen-level pending_state from closed indicators at observation; executable candle uses state observed at previous bucket strictly before its open. Missing state/data becomes DATA_GAP; no historical reconstruction.
rules.incremental_evaluator: Replay one closed eligible candle with the frozen evaluator; transient clock adapter satisfies original full-study clock validator and restores original signal time/created/expiry. Enforce original expiry before/after adapter. OPEN cursor progresses with closed future bars only.
rules.outcome: Original fixed-entry/SL/TP, strict confirmation, fill/exit same-bar AMBIGUOUS, later TP+SL AMBIGUOUS, adverse stop gaps, DATA_GAP freezes uncertain capital. No generated fills on skipped capture candle.
rules.coverage: First attempt per bucket; same bucket retry never overwrites/adds evidence. Disclose missing/late buckets and indicator validity.
rules.portfolio: Original 10000USDC/1% research risk/3 positions/3% total/1x notional/JST daily3%; reserve at actual observed time. Independent each-week accounts plus continuous ledger across weeks; unknown capital never released. This differs from the user actual 3% one-position/no-daily-stop account.
rules.comparison: Same capture restrictions for current control; deduplicate setup IDs and fills. Report proposal-only/shared/current-missing/net count differences. Capped shared IDs unavailable: null. No combining replay or existing pending live samples.
rules.stop: Review only, never automatically kill/promote/tune/order. Sufficient negative performance records KILL and stops new registrations only after separately tested explicit engineering change; existing OPEN remains tracked.

review_gates.kill: Any adequately observed period >=20 resolved with net AvgR<=0 or PF<=1 (zero tolerance 1e-12) kills this specification, skips unused periods and future activation. Do not retune.
review_gates.practical_candidate: Both complete unobserved-at-registration validation periods each >=50 resolved, win_rate>=40%, base AvgR>0/PF>=1.2, stress AvgR>0/PF>1, uncapped and capped pure fill increase vs current>0, capped >=20 resolved, no remaining OPEN/uncertain capital and known closed portfolio ROI>0. Then require separate captured-live Shadow and execution-quality validation; no promotion.
review_gates.insufficient: INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE or incomplete/unknown ROI: wait without replacing this specification. Do not count repeated daily/cohort updates or source replay as independent forward samples.
review_gates.quality: Source hash/ledger/control economics mismatch stops the experiment. Source failures block practical qualification. Ambiguous/gap cases remain disclosed and are not removed to create positive ROI.
review_gates.comparison: Independent setup IDs do not imply comparable lifecycle IDs; report shared ticker/side/signal-close timestamps, proposal-only/current-missing events, uncapped and capped net fill count differences. Capped shared events unavailable in frozen portfolio, keep null.

limitations: Hypothetical OHLC touch capture, not real orders or queue/fill proof.
Do not add overlapping historical and live results as independent samples.
Existing VWAP historical weekly protocol and all failed models remain unchanged.
Missed session/strict origin may lower captured opportunity count; do not relax after results.
Costs exclude funding, spread, tick and queue; portfolio ROI requires modeled allocation and all capital resolved.
